counterfactual_missing_items: no cardiac MRI or PET evidence of inflammation or late gadolinium enhancement
pulmonary nodules are only incidentally noted and are nonspecific for cardiac sarcoidosis
decisive_items: Based on an epsilon wave in V1–V3, T-wave inversions in V1–V3 with QRS >110 ms, an RV outflow tract dimension >32 mm, and severe RV dilation and hypokinesia, arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia was highly suspected
response.rationale: R1 is directly supported by multiple raw diagnostic criteria for ARVD, including epsilon wave, right ventricular dilation and hypokinesia, and the explicit statement that ARVD was highly suspected. R2 is supported only by the differential-diagnosis mention and incidental pulmonary nodules, without any raw confirmatory sarcoidosis findings.

rejected.why: Only supported by the differential-diagnosis sentence and incidental pulmonary nodules; it lacks specific raw evidence of cardiac sarcoidosis and is explicitly framed as remaining in the differential after ARVD was highly suspected.
